days.file: Brooklyn Museum - Jesus Mary Magdalene and Martha at Bethany (Jésus à Bethanie Marie Madeleine et Marthe) - James Tissot.jpg
days.title: Jesus, Mary Magdalene and Martha at Bethany
days.alt: Jesus, in a white robe, sits on a garden wall beside several women in head-coverings who bow in sorrow, one with her head on the steps.
days.look: Look again at the bowed heads gathered near Jesus. What would you lay down before him today?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Saint Thomas Aquinas
days.alt: St. Thomas Aquinas, in the black Dominican cloak, holds an open book of close writing and a small model church.
days.look: Look again at the open page in Thomas’s hands. What is the one small piece you can write today?
days.license: Artist died 1495; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Jean-François Millet - The Sower - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Sower
days.alt: A farm worker in a worn jacket strides across a dark field, flinging seed from his open hand.
days.look: Look again at the open hand of the sower. What seed could you throw down today, rough as it is?
days.license: Artist died 1875; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Rembrandt, The Baptism of the Eunuch, 1626, Museum Catharijneconvent, Utrecht.jpg
days.title: The Baptism of the Eunuch
days.alt: A bearded man in an orange robe gestures toward an open book held by a man in turquoise, with horses and a cart behind them.
days.look: Look again at the open hand pointing to the book. Like the traveler who asked for a guide, whose help could you ask for this week?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - The Miraculous Draught of Fishes (La pêche miraculeuse) - James Tissot - overall.jpg
days.title: The Miraculous Draught of Fishes
days.alt: In a fishing boat, men in tunics haul a net heavy with fish while Christ, in white, kneels at the far end.
days.look: Look again at the net, full after a night of nothing. Where will you try once more at his word?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Albrecht Dürer, Saint Jerome in His Study, 1514, NGA 6642.jpg
days.title: Saint Jerome in His Study
days.alt: St. Jerome, haloed and bearded, bends over a slanted writing desk at a table, pen in hand, in a sunlit room.
days.look: Look again at Jerome bent over his page, pen in hand. Is there any corner of your work you would rather hide?
days.license: Artist died 1528; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: CC0)

days.title: Elijah in the Desert
days.alt: An angel in white kneels beside the weary prophet Elijah, one hand on his arm, the other pointing to bread and a jug of water.
days.look: Look again at the angel pointing the worn-out prophet to the bread and water. What strength is God already setting beside you?
days.license: Painted 1834; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Alexander Heubel - Moses, Aaron and Hur - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Moses, Aaron and Hur
days.alt: Moses with his arms raised sits between Aaron and Hur, who steady him on a mountain top.
days.look: Look again at the two men holding up Moses. Who is holding you up right now?
days.license: Artist died 1856; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Albrecht Dürer - The Four Apostles, Saints John, Peter, Mark and Paul.jpg
days.title: The Four Apostles (Saint Paul)
days.alt: St. Paul, bald and bearded in a pale cloak, looks to the side with a steady gaze and a book at his chest, while St. Mark peers over his shoulder.
days.look: Look again at Paul’s steady gaze above the book. However this work ends, what would you want to be able to say to God about how you ran?
days.license: Artist died 1528; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
